answer_text:
Mobile apps vary a lot: some are full CRMs, others are read-only companions. The ones people rate highly on phones:

1. Pipewell Go - pipeline-first and very visual; a good pick if your process is mostly deal stages.
2. Northwind CRM Essentials - powerful and well supported, though per-seat costs climb quickly past the starter tier.
3. Sheetly - the cheapest route: a shared sheet with CRM templates.

Trial Pipewell and Northwind CRM side by side with a real week of deals — the better fit is usually obvious by Friday.

mentions.name: Pipewell
mentions.sentiment_reason: Presented as a strong option with concrete strengths.

mentions.name: Northwind CRM
mentions.sentiment_reason: Strengths are noted alongside a clear drawback.

mentions.name: Sheetly
mentions.sentiment_reason: Listed factually without praise or criticism.
